title: Forecasting wholesale prices of Canchán potatoes using artificial intelligence models with data from the Ministry of Agrarian Development and Irrigation of Peru (2020–2025)
abstract: We compare SARIMAX, RNN, LSTM and hybrid models to forecast the monthly price of Canchán potatoes from MIDAGRI data. Prioritising stability and real generalisation over minimum error, LSTM-XGBoost proved the most robust; the result is a reproducible framework for other crops.

title: Application of dimensionality reduction and clustering techniques for the analysis of Carrion's disease cases in the period 2000–2024
abstract: An exploratory epidemiology framework over 43,000+ Carrion's disease records (2000–2024). FAMD + K-Means gave the best clustering quality and identified two distinct, stable epidemiological profiles to support public-health surveillance.

title: Comparing Boosting models in blended education
abstract: Comparison of Boosting-family models to predict academic performance in blended courses.
